about_the_game:
Note: This is a demo version of Veilborne Sacrament. The final game will differ significantly in content, visuals, and overall experience.

Veilborne Sacrament is a psychological horror experience that traps you in a decaying world where reality begins to break apart.

Explore shadowed corridors, uncover cryptic mechanisms, and solve intricate puzzles that guard the truth hidden within the mansion’s walls.
Every step draws you deeper into an atmosphere of dread — and something within the dark learns with every move you make.

Features:
• Psychological horror focused on tension and atmosphere rather than gore
• Complex, interconnected puzzles inspired by classic survival horror
• A dynamic AI entity that stalks and reacts to your actions (not available in the demo)
• Immersive environments rich in detail and sound design
• A story shrouded in mystery, slowly revealed through exploration and discovery

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains disturbing imagery, psychological horror themes, and mild depictions of blood and death.
Some scenes include lifeless bodies and unsettling environments.
No sexual or explicit content is present.
